q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of plastic buttons per 1,000?
title: Plastic button footprint per 1,000 buttons
short: Weigh the polyester resin or other plastic per thousand buttons and multiply by the supplier's figure. Add casting or moulding, curing, cutting and polishing energy, then divide the unit's energy by thousands of buttons made.

ul: Polyester resin, ABS or nylon by weight.
Sheet or rod casting, or injection moulding.

p: Report per thousand buttons by line size, since buttons are traded by the gross or thousand.

example.title: Worked example: plastic button unit per 1,000 buttons (one month)
lines: Plant total: 5,680 / 20,000 = 0.284 kg CO2 per 1,000 buttons
Add resin and packing for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
